name: Superhuman
summary: Productivity suite combining Superhuman Mail, Grammarly, Coda-based Docs and the Go assistant.
description: Superhuman is now the name of a suite that includes Superhuman Mail, Grammarly, Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda) and Go, an AI assistant that works across other apps, plus agents and a calendar. The Free plan gives AI assistance in common apps, Grammarly and Docs. Paid plans start at $12 per member per month billed annually, with business and enterprise tiers above it.

howToUse.title: Open Superhuman
howToUse.description: Open the Superhuman suite. It includes Mail, Docs (formerly Coda), Go, agents and a calendar.

howToUse.title: Work where you already type
howToUse.description: Go is the assistant that works across the apps you already have. The suite gives assistance in common apps on the Free plan, Grammarly included.

howToUse.title: Look at paid tiers
howToUse.description: Paid tiers start at $12 per member per month when billed annually. Business and enterprise tiers sit above that price.
